lines.base_description: Customs value (CIF: cost, insurance and freight to the EU border)

incomplete_reasons: import VAT: import VAT is set by each member state: pass the member state of import as destination (e.g. destination=de)

notes: A preference is available for United States (eu-us-tariff-adjustment: 0.000 %) with proof of origin: set proof_of_origin=true.
Low-value consignment customs duty: 3.000 EUR (measure type 107, Regulation 0382/26) applies to particular consignments and is not included in the totals; see other_charges.
Union handling fee: 2.000 EUR (measure type 800, Regulation 2108/26) applies to particular consignments and is not included in the totals; see other_charges.

customs_value.rule: CIF: the cost of transport and insurance of the goods, and loading and handling charges associated with their transport, up to the place where they are brought into the customs territory of the Union are part of the customs value (Union Customs Code, Regulation (EU) No 952/2013, Article 71(1)(e)).

vat_value.rule: On importation the taxable amount is the value for customs purposes, plus taxes, duties, levies and other charges due by reason of importation (excluding the VAT itself) and incidental expenses such as commission, packing, transport and insurance up to the first place of destination in the member state of importation (VAT Directive 2006/112/EC, Articles 85 and 86).
